head: 5a11be68b6fe7b1fc2a3d3120fcbebfffd403e5a
reviewer: Claude Opus 5.5 (independent reviewer for the F23 delivery session)
scope: The full diff main..f23-alternative-diagnostics at 5a11be68b and the design hunk of engineering 6b26f1e0d: Governed, unresolved, resolved, governing, defaults, layer, copies, compiled, briefed, routes, unused_pairs and substituted in cli.py; closure.py brief_of and briefing; tags.py; test_cli.py; both fixtures; docs/selection.md, dispatch.md, composition.md, glossary.md, invocation.md and fixtures/README.md. Twelve scratch scenarios covered composed copies beside a default pair, fragment keys, picking dispatches with other tags, a picking and a plain dispatch of equal tags, dispatched bundles and parallel dispatch. Excluded with its arising issue: a picking dispatch to an alternative naming its own brief (https://github.com/m2ux/prosiform/issues/807), later folded into #800 as AC4 and reviewed in round three.
criteria: AC1: the agreeing-default-pair fixture passes and a composed copy warns. AC2: the routed-brief fixture names the brief; the remedy text held by the test_cli test. AC3: each make check target. AC2 failed under finding 1.
validation: pytest, corpus 682 of 682, ruff, mypy, invocation, conformance, independence, harness, links and vocabulary passed at 5a11be68b.

findings.description: resolved tested the brief remedy on the first composing reference of a copy group keyed by tags alone, so an unrouted directive written first was blamed, and a routed picking brief behind it got the copy remedy.
A picking dispatch whose target's alternative names its own brief is remedied by naming an alternative, and the failure names no dispatch.
With a plain and a picking dispatch of equal tags, the location could name the plain dispatch while the remedy names the picking one.
invocation.md stated the alternative remedy without the picking-dispatch brief case.
docs/glossary.md and design.md:515 defined a routing pair without the stand-in exception docs/selection.md states.
The routes docstring restated the stand-in rule layer owns, and the layer docstring's declaration-order phrase read as covering default.
The routed-brief fixture's description promised a remedy its manifest cannot assert.
No test held an agreeing default pair in a composed copy.
